gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah has a fat midsection and a jaw-open c. Goldman's wide, parenthesis-round capitals above it make a long stretch of text feel sturdy yet easy to move through.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-batak: Commanding Goldman spreads its round, wide letters across the top, while Noto Sans Batak stacks a towering x-height beneath it. That body goes down easily over many lines.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali reads with capitals barely above its lowercase and mouths that stay plainly open, a sans-serif of quiet modern manners. Goldman does the shouting; this one does the explaining.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki packs its lowercase tight, like coiled rope. Goldman's wide, bold letters stretch out above it, so the heavy heading and the dense, approachable text push against each other nicely.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi reads contemporary and restrained, its mean line set high and every curve left open at the end. Goldman's broad, bold width against that quiet body is the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Wide, bold, and a bit swaggering. Noto Sans Buhid follows with a high x-height and generous gaps where curves meet stems, a plain sans that makes Goldman's width the standout quality.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-carian: Goldman's lowercase stands unusually tall against its capitals, and the letters sit far apart, which gives headings real command. Noto Sans Carian does the quieter job, keeping its terminals open like scissor blades for steady reading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Goldman's round forms look like open parentheses, spaced wide and bold for headings that command attention. Noto Sans Chakma handles the reading, its lowercase packed up close to the caps with uncrowded s and c shapes.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-cham: Goldman is wide, bold, and round, with a lowercase that nearly rivals its capitals. Noto Sans Cham keeps tall rounded letters and open c shapes, so shrinking the heading would waste Goldman's width.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Goldman's lowercase runs big beside its capitals, and its round forms are spaced out wide and bold. Noto Sans Cherokee brings an approachable tall band of letters with an e left wide at its terminal, which is the pair's strongest charm.
